summary: 8 changes specced against the assessment's gaps, honouring the analyze verdict of ZERO new third-party dependencies (adopt UAR's published image; reuse librefang's own supervisor and reqwest/futures/tokio-stream stack). C-002 is a HARD BLOCKER in GQAdonis/universal-agent-runtime: the `uar-sidecar` binary is never built (0 refs in release.yml; Dockerfile:225 builds only --bin universal-agent-runtime), so nothing exists to COPY, resolve, or spawn. C-001 and C-003 are independently shippable and deliver real value before any UAR change lands: C-001 removes the surrealdb lockstep pin and UAR's whole transitive tree from the default build, and C-003 fixes the reported bug's actual mechanism (resolve_sidecar_command is hardcoded to the Telegram stem, so UAR falls through to a bare PATH lookup) plus replaces the opaque `os error 2` with an error naming every path searched.
